source.method: ScrapeCreators API: instagram list-user-2 (highlight albums) and list-user-5 (album items). Media and Instagram metadata (taken_at, media_type, video_duration, sticker fields) per frame in frames-meta.json; contact sheets sheet-*.jpg in this folder.
source.scope_limit: Highlights only (5 albums, 59 frames, posted 2023-08-10 to 2026-05-11). The API exposes no live-Stories endpoint, so his current 24-hour Stories are not in this file. Frame text was read from the images by eye; 26 TESTIMONY videos were read from one still each, not transcribed.
source.sticker_metadata_found: reel_mentions on 14 frames, one story_location (Dubai). No link, poll, question or quiz stickers are stored on any highlight frame; the one Ask Me Anything box (ARISTOCRAT 9) is part of the image.

system.summary: Highlights work as a permanent sales page in five sections: who I am (ARISTOCRAT), proof from clients in their own voice (TESTIMONY), proof as numbers (RESULTS), the offer (JOIN NEXUS) and hiring (HIRING). Every designed frame ends in a reply keyword, so a Story reply becomes a DM conversation.
system.cta_model: Reply-with-keyword, never a link sticker. Keywords seen: LAST TIME, NEXUS, VIRAL FLOW, EDITOR, SETTER. The keyword sits low in the frame with an arrow pointing down toward Instagram's reply bar.

brand_system.ground: near-black navy (#0E0B1F-ish) with a faint grid and soft purple glow, same on every designed frame
brand_system.headline: heavy uppercase sans, white, centred near the top (about y 280 to 420 of 1920)
brand_system.key_value_marker: the number or result in each headline sits in a red rectangle (e.g. [65K VIEWS], [$12K CONVERSION])
brand_system.evidence: real screenshots: Discord/Skool-style community messages with avatar, name, text and emoji reactions; Stripe 'Succeeded' payments; Instagram insight panels; reel thumbnails with play counts (e.g. '1.1M')
brand_system.connector: one red hand-drawn arrow from the claim or message to the number it proves
brand_system.time_tags: 'AS OF TODAY' and 'BACK THEN' stamps for before and after
brand_system.people: every win names a real client (Ben, Robin, Ryan, Janek, SooWei, Gene, Katana, Alvin) with their face as the avatar

kit_mapping.note: How each Devin habit matches the Full Visual kit rules (artifacts/creative/2026-10-20-full-visual-bland-claude/.claude/skills/full-visual*).

rules.devin: Headline names a real person and a number: 'RYAN HITTING 250K VIEWS IN JUST 48 HOURS'
rules.kit: Hook test 1 and 3: a real named thing in the first four words, a number

rules.devin: One win per frame, same skeleton every time (name, result, time, screenshot, arrow)
rules.kit: Repeated proof unit: your thing, what happened, the number, what it means; the last one escalates
One key word per caption block in the selection box
Real material only; redraw only the parts the sentence needs
Every change belongs to a word: the static version is a visible link from claim to evidence
A change of state happens to the object already on screen (before and after of one account)
CTA says exactly what arrives: comment KEYWORD and I'll send it

rules.devin: Same dark template on every proof frame
rules.kit: One continuous thing per reel: the template is the thread that turns many wins into one sequence

differs_from_kit: Stories are tapped, not heard: no voice clock, so sync becomes layout (headline, then evidence, then arrow, top to bottom).
Several screenshots per frame (up to 3) where the kit wants one focus; Devin keeps one hero screenshot big and the rest smaller.

sequence_types.pattern: Every frame is one client win on the dark template. Every 3 to 4 frames a CTA frame. One 'COMMUNITY WINS DUMP' title card opens a new run (frame 7). It ends on selfie frames that say why it works.

sequence_types.pattern: Raw client selfie videos (4 to 60 s, long ones split into 60 s chunks), captions burned in by the client or Devin, the client's @handle bottom right. No template, no graphics beyond captions; the proof is the person talking.

Candid moments that show the life the business pays for (terrace view, studio shoot, his set, night city, first-class to Dubai, Dubai balcony, a lighter 'listen to the ping', speaking on stage, group yacht trip with an Ask Me Anything box). Text is one short lowercase serif line or none.

frame_template.text: one short line, small, lowercase italic serif

sequence_types.pattern: One frame: his photo, verified handle, 'JOIN NEXUS.', a one-line promise ('Helping Online Business Owners Create Predictable & Profitable Content'), REPLY WITH "NEXUS" and a row of down arrows.
One frame per role: avatar, 'HIRING {ROLE}' in a role colour, 2 to 3 requirement pills, pay range, REPLY WITH "{ROLE}" in a box.

Mac Photos library: 22,071 items, 3,840 screenshots (client wins, Stripe, dashboards likely among them; not yet reviewed)
Comment and direct-DM keyword automation (GHL to n8n router ZLrzPqqMf96PoJje, dm_keyword_assets) that already replies to Instagram DMs
Headless-Chrome cover template from the kit (artifacts/creative/pipeline-tests-2026-10-20/kit-heygen/cover-harness2/cover.html)
steps: 1. Wins inventory: pull candidate screenshots from the Photos library (Photos' own screenshot flag and its OCR search index, read locally), Antonio picks which are shareable; each win stored as {client, result, number, timeframe, screenshot, source, date}.

2. Results template: one HTML template on our brand (C2C dark #0A0A0A, #2780FF blue instead of his purple), headline with a highlighted number box, hero screenshot, red arrow, optional BACK THEN / AS OF TODAY, rendered at 1080x1920 in headless Chrome like the covers.

3. Sequence builder: proof_stack becomes 'one win per frame, a reply-keyword frame every 3 to 4', opened by a 'WINS DUMP' title card; keyword maps to an existing dm_keyword_assets row so a Story reply gets the resource.
4. Lifestyle frames stay (ARISTOCRAT model) with one short line, matched by the photo tags built on Oct 20.
5. Offer card for the C2C offer with its keyword.
6. Testimonials only if Antonio has client videos with permission.
7. Verify that an Instagram Story reply containing the keyword reaches the DM keyword router (not yet tested).
